meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Slack 频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你开发的应用需要 Slack 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Slack chat in your app

howto.what: 把 Slack 适配器复制并注册进项目，安装固定版依赖，然后引导你创建 Slack 应用、选择 Socket 或 Webhook、填入凭据并重启服务；之后 Claude 就能通过 Slack 收发消息。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加 Slack 渠道集成（例如说“添加 Slack”“配置 Slack”）时触发；若正在进行 /setup，流程也会调用此技能。

say.text: 帮我把 Slack 集成到项目里
say.note: 会复制 Slack 适配器并开始配置流程
会引导你完成应用创建和事件接收设置
会要求你选择 Socket 或 Webhook 并粘贴凭据

howto.what_en: Adds Slack channel support: copies the adapter, registers it, installs pinned dependency, then guides through creating a Slack app, choosing Socket Mode or webhook, storing tokens, and restarting so Claude can send/receive Slack messages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add Slack channel integration (e.g., saying 'add Slack' or 'configure Slack'), or during the /setup flow when Slack is selected.

say_en.text: Add Slack integration to the project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and starts the config flow
Guides you through app creation and event setup
Asks you to choose socket/webhook and paste credentials
